exposure: Infants were grouped into: vaginally delivered and exclusively breastfed (VB), cesarean delivered and exclusively breastfed (CB), and cesarean delivered and mixed-fed (CM)
Feeding pattern (exclusive breastfeeding vs. mixed feeding)
cohort: 120 infants at 6 weeks postpartum at a single center in China
finding: Delivery mode and feeding pattern, but not postnatal antibiotic exposure, had significant impacts on the infant gut microbiome at 6 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with altered gut microbiota, but exclusive breastfeeding partially restored this disturbance compared to mixed feeding.
